article.title: World War Z and the Hollywood hasbara apparatus
article.author: Sherronda J. Brown
article.content: A century of Hollywood hasbara has worked to desensitize Western audiences to Israel’s war crimes and to normalize the prioritization of Israel's political and military interests. The entertainment industry's complicity is a necropolitical tool of zombifying Palestinians and sustaining Israel's death-world. Read more via Scalawag : World War Z and the Hollywood hasbara apparatus .
